summary: HNO International filed an 8-K reporting a September 4, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement with CFI Capital LLC for a $210,000 convertible redeemable note (OID $21,000, net $189,000), maturing September 4, 2027, bearing 6% interest. Conversion begins after six months at 60% of the 20-day lowest trading price, adjusting to 50% on a DTC chill and 45% on default, capped at 4.99% beneficial ownership. The Company reserved 49,295,775 shares and included most-favored-nation terms. This is a routine dilutive financing, not a special situation.
